name: 越冬保温（加热功率）计算

map.输入养殖水体体积、目标温差、加热时长与保温效率，估算越冬保温所需加热功率与电量。: Enter pond water volume, target temperature rise, heating duration and insulation efficiency to estimate the heating power and energy needed for overwintering.
map.所需热量 Q = 1.163 × V × ΔT ÷ η（kWh，1.163 =: Heat required Q = 1.163 × V × ΔT ÷ η (kWh; 1.163 = 1000×4.186/3600, i.e. 1 m³ of water raised 1 ℃ needs about 1.163 kWh; η is the insulation efficiency as a decimal); average heating power P = Q ÷ t (kW, t is the heating duration in hours); recommended configured power = 1.2 × P (1.2× safety margin). Validation: water volume, temperature rise and duration must be > 0, and insulation efficiency must be 1–100%, otherwise the field is flagged.
map.按水体体积、目标温差、加热时长与保温效率估算所需热量与加热功率；含 1.2 倍安: Estimate the heat required and heating power from water volume, target temperature rise, heating duration and insulation efficiency, including a 1.2× safety margin for configured power.
map.💡 1 m³ 水升温 1 ℃ 约需 1.163 kWh；加热功率 P ≈ 1.1: 💡 Raising 1 m³ of water by 1 ℃ needs about 1.163 kWh; heating power P ≈ 1.163×V×ΔT÷(η×t), then size the equipment at 1.2× this value.
map.P=ρ·V·c·ΔT/(η·t)（水的比热 4186 J/kg·K，η 为保温效: P=ρ·V·c·ΔT/(η·t) (water specific heat 4186 J/kg·K, η = insulation efficiency)

map.功率按 1.2~1.3 倍选型: Size power at 1.2–1.3× the calculated value

V=100 m³, ΔT=10 ℃, insulation efficiency 85%, 24 h heating: Q = 1.163×100×10÷0.85 ≈ 1368.2 kWh; P = 1368.2÷24 ≈ 57.01 kW; with a 1.2× margin, configure about 68.41 kW.
map.1 m³ 水质量约 1000 kg，比热 4.186 kJ/(kg·K)，升温: 1 m³ of water weighs about 1000 kg and has a specific heat of 4.186 kJ/(kg·K), so raising it 1 ℃ needs 4186 kJ; since 1 kWh = 3600 kJ, that is about 1.163 kWh.
map.加热过程中池壁、水面会持续散热，实际耗电高于理论热量；效率越低，所需配置功率越大: Pond walls and the water surface keep losing heat, so actual energy use exceeds the theoretical heat; the lower the efficiency, the larger the required power. Use 60%–95% depending on greenhouse or open-pond conditions.
